content.title: Are banks and the post office open on Easter Monday? What to know
content.text: April 5, 2026, 6:03 a.m. ETHoly Week in 2026 began on Palm Sunday, March 29, and concluded on Easter Sunday, April 5.Easter Monday, observed on April 6, 2026, is a public holiday in over 100 countries but not in the United States.Federal offices, banks, the U.S. Postal Service, and the stock market will be open on Easter Monday in the U.S.The White House traditionally hosts its annual Easter Egg Roll for the public on Easter Monday.Holy Week, one of the most important weeks on the Christian calendar, has ended.Easter is observed worldwide with church services, including Good Friday commemorations of Christ's crucifixion and Easter Sunday worship, as well as traditions such as sunrise services, family gatherings and festive meals. Easter eggs, often associated with renewal and new life, are a common symbol of the holiday.In 2026, Holy Week began with Palm Sunday on March 29 and concluded on Easter Sunday, April 5, when Christians celebrate the resurrection of Jesus Christ. The week also marks the end of Lent, the 40‑day season of fasting, prayer and reflection that concludes on Holy Thursday.Easter Monday, observed the day after Easter, is recognized by Christians across the globe and is a public holiday in many countries, including Canada, the United Kingdom and much of Europe.Here's what to know about Easter Monday and stock market, offices and schools open on April 6, 2026:Easter week 2026 dates, timelineEaster week, or Holy Week, stretches from Palm Sunday, when Jesus rode into Jerusalem, to Easter Sunday, the day he rose from the dead, according to the New Testament. In 2026, Easter week was March 29 to April 5.March 29: Palm Sunday. Jesus enters Jerusalem on a donkey and is greeted by people with palm branches, a symbol of victory.March 30: Holy MondayMarch 31: Holy TuesdayApril 1: Holy Wednesday, also known as Good Wednesday, Silent Wednesday or Spy Wednesday, the latter referring to the day Judas secretly agrees to betray Jesus.April 2: Maundy Thursday. Jesus shares the Last Supper with his disciples and washes their feet. Also the official end of Lent.April 3: Good Friday. Jesus dies on the cross.April 4: Holy Saturday, or Black Saturday, is a day of mourning while Jesus rests in the tomb.April 5: Easter Sunday. Jesus rises from the dead.When is Easter 2026?Easter is celebrated on Sunday, April 5, 2026.What is Easter Monday?Easter Monday celebrates the day after Jesus Christ's resurrection. According to History, several countries observe Easter Monday as a public holiday.In the third or fourth century, Christians began extending the Easter celebration, which originally ended on Easter Sunday, to eight days, per History.Easter Monday is known by various other names, including:Bright MondayRenewal MondayLittle EasterMonday of the AngelsIs Easter Monday a federal holiday?No. Easter Monday is not recognized as a federal holiday. Federal offices and banks are open.Are banks open on Easter Monday?Yes, banks will be open on Easter Monday, April 6, 2026.Is the post office open? Is there mail delivery on Easter Monday?Since Easter Monday is not a public holiday, there will be mail delivery and U.S. Postal Service post offices will be open Monday, April 6.Are schools in Florida open Easter Monday?One Florida district is out of school on Easter Monday, but not because of Easter. Hamilton County's spring break runs April 6-10.Is the DMV open on Easter Monday?Yes. State offices, including Florida Highway Safety and Motor Vehicles, are open Easter Monday, April 6.Is the stock market open on Easter Monday?Yes. The stock market – NYSE and Nasdaq – and Bond Market are open Easter Monday, April 6, 2026, for regular trading hours, 9:30 a.m. to 4 p.m. ET. Markets were closed for Good Friday, April 3.White House Easter Egg Roll held on Easter MondayThe White House Easter Egg Roll, traditionally planned by first ladies, has been held on Easter Monday since the 1870s.Introduced by first lady Nancy Reagan in 1981, it is now customary for guests leaving the event to receive a commemorative wooden Easter egg signed by the president and first lady.White House Easter Egg Roll tickets are free and awarded via an online lottery.The White House also seeks volunteers to help with the event.What is the Easter Monday Act?The Easter Monday Act of 2025 is a bill to amend title 5 of the United States Code to designate Easter Monday as a legal public holiday.The bill, sponsored by Sen. Eric Schmitt (R-Missouri) was introduced in the U.S. Senate on April 10, 2025, and referred to the Senate Judiciary Committee, where it still sits.A related House bill, H.R. 2951, also named Easter Monday Act of 2025, introduced April 17, 2025, by Rep. Riley Moore (R-West Virginia) was referred to House Oversight and Government Reform Committee, where no action has yet been taken.Kim Luciani is a journalist for the USA TODAY Network-Florida's Audience team.
